scripts.dev: bun run codegen & bun run dev:web & bun run dev:api
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:api
scripts.bump: bunx npm-check-updates -u --workspaces --root && bun install && bun run update:bun
scripts.bump:interactive: bunx npm-check-updates -i --workspaces --root && bun install && bun run update:bun
scripts.bump:minor: bunx npm-check-updates -u --workspaces --root --target minor && bun install && bun run update:bun
scripts.bump:patch: bunx npm-check-updates -u --workspaces --root --target patch && bun install && bun run update:bun
scripts.codegen: cd apps/api && bun run codegen && cd ../web && bun run codegen
